mu_name_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN} and so on, and the numbering runs one over MU's zero-based classes - so Class01 is the Dark Wizard.
part_note: The boots, 210 triangles. Bound to 48 on Bip01 L Calf, 48 on Bip01 R Calf, 38 on Bip01 L Foot, 38 on Bip01 R Foot.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkinClass101.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Dark Wizard's parts name it.
unstack_why: Refuses the UV un-stacking, as ArmorClass01 does and for the reason found there: the step moved 69 of that part's 150 faces off their twin and the buckled vest vanished from the bake. Every part of this body is mirrored the same way - this one arrives 100% stacked and 63 of its faces get moved - so the same damage is available to all of them, and MU sharing one set of texels between a left and a right half is the arrangement rather than a defect to undo.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Dark Wizard body, read out of Data/Player/BootClass01.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's BootClass01 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("okey lets make new dw and sm then", after seeing the two side by side). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.
